fluff.overview: Clan doctrine generally treats conventional infantry as a necessary evil, though Clans like Hell's Horses have demonstrated that properly supported infantry can be an effective component of combined-arms operations. Foot Points are the most basic infantry formation, deployed on foot without transport. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they are best suited to garrison duty, facility security, and defensive positions where their lack of mobility is less of a liability. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon available, these Points deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
